title: Directed affine limit preservation for categories fibred in groupoids
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\mathcal F$ be a category fibred in groupoids over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For $T/S$, write $\mathcal F(T)$ for its fibre groupoid. We say that $\mathcal F$ is limit preserving if for every nonempty small directed inverse system $(T_i)$ of affine $S$-schemes with affine limit $T$, the natural functor $2\operatorname{colim}_i\mathcal F(T_i)\to\mathcal F(T)$ is an equivalence. Explicitly: every object over $T$ is pulled back from a stage; every arrow between two stage objects pulled back to $T$ is pulled back from a common later stage, compatibly with the specified pullback identifications; and if two stage arrows become equal over $T$, they become equal at a later stage. No descent for coverings is required.
